title: Slug resolve response
description: The 200 body of GET /wp-json/resource-hub/v1/resolve?slug={slug}: the current canonical identity of a public resource that is, or once was, reachable at that slug. The front end calls it when a resource URL misses, so a renamed resource redirects to its new URL instead of returning a 404. A slug that matches no public resource, now or before, is answered with a WordPress REST 404 (wp-error.schema.json).

id.description: The post ID of the resource the slug resolves to.

type.description: The resource's current resource_type slug, the first variable segment of its canonical URL /resources/[type]/[slug]/. Never topic or page.

slug.description: The resource's current slug. Equal to the queried slug when the resource was found under its current name, different when the query used an old slug.
